raw_translation: Kuskure: ba a haɗi da waƙar maƙwabcin; an cire waƙarka.
source: Foul: opponent disc was not contacted; your disc is removed.
translation: Kuskure: ba a haɗi da waƙar maƙwabcin; an cire waƙarka.

back_sample.translation: Place and rotate small ball shapes on the 10×10 map. Fill a line or a column to clear it and continue playing.

raw_translation: Ka sanya da kuma juya siffofin kwalaye masu ƙaranci a kan taswirar ZXQPH0000QXZ×ZXQPH0001QXZ. Ka cika wani layi ko kuma wani tsagi don ka tsarkake shi kuma ka ci gaba da wasa.
source: Place and rotate small block shapes on a 10×10 board. Fill a complete row or column to clear it and keep playing.
translation: Ka sanya da kuma juya siffofin kwalaye masu ƙaranci a kan taswirar 10×10. Ka cika wani layi ko kuma wani tsagi don ka tsarkake shi kuma ka ci gaba da wasa.
